rationale: The description details cross-platform data-center monitoring, display of system state/health/performance, and alerts tied to identified availability, performance, configuration, or security situations.
evidence_spans: cross-platform data center monitoring system for operating systems and hypervisors
shows state, health, and performance information of computer systems
alerts generated according to some availability, performance, configuration, or security situation being identified
conflict_response: I remove the unsupported implication that alerts are rule-based: the text only says they are generated according to identified situations. Monitoring, displaying system metrics, and situation-triggered alerts remain meaningful conventional functions; no alert implementation is inferred.
